flips: UT-01 (Salt Lake City & West Valley City)

summaries.senate: Polymarket odds for Democratic control of the Senate rose sharply, and the party is now the market's favoured side. The Democratic candidates Adam Hamilton in [[Kansas]] and Josh Turek in [[Iowa]] both gained ground sharply, and each of those races is a predicted flip. In [[Ohio]], the Democrat Sherrod Brown also made a sizable gain, and that race is likewise a predicted flip.
summaries.governor: In Vermont, Polymarket odds show a sharp climb for the Democrat Amanda Janoo, a predicted flip. Nevada looks similar, where the Democrat Aaron Ford gained ground sharply and the market also lists it as a predicted flip. Georgia saw a sharp rise for the Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms, likewise a predicted flip, while in [[Florida]] the Republican Byron Donalds strengthened sharply.
summaries.house: Polymarket odds show Democrats, the favoured party for House control, gaining a moderate amount of ground. In [[NC-13 (Fuquay-Varina & Sanford)]], the Democrat Paul Barringer made a sharp gain and the seat is a predicted flip, while in [[FL-09 (Orlando & Kissimmee)]] the Democrat Darren Soto also saw a sharp rise in their chances. The projected seat count moved to 251-184, up from 250-185, which means Democrats gain control, with [[FL-13 (Clearwater & Largo)]] and NV-02 (Reno & Sparks) newly predicted flips.
